PALLET_OAK_HEY_WAIT:
OAK: Hey! Wait!
Don't go out!
PALLET_OAK_CLOSE_CALL:
OAK: That was
close! Wild POKéMON live
in tall grass!
PALLET_OAK_COME_WITH_ME:
OAK: A POKéMON can
appear anytime in
tall grass. You need your own
POKéMON for your
protection.
I know! Here, come with
me!
LAB_RIVAL_FED_UP:
<RIVAL>: Gramps!
I'm fed up with
waiting!
LAB_OAK_CHOOSE_MON_1:
OAK: Hmm? <RIVAL>?
Why are you here
already? I said for you to
come by later...
LAB_OAK_BE_PATIENT:
OAK: Be patient,
<RIVAL>, I'll give
you one later.
LAB_RIVAL_ILL_GET_BETTER:
<RIVAL>: Humph!
I'll get a better
POKéMON than you!
LAB_OAK_DONT_GO:
OAK: Hey! Don't go
away yet!
LAB_RIVAL_NO_WAY:
<RIVAL>: No way!
<PLAYER>, I want
this POKéMON!
LAB_OAK_ALL_RIGHT:
OAK: But, I... Oh,
all right then.
That POKéMON is
yours. I was going to
give you one
anyway... <PLAYER>, come over
here.
LAB_OAK_GIVES_PIKACHU:
OAK: <PLAYER>, this
is the POKéMON I
caught earlier. You can have it.
I caught it in
the wild and it's
not tame yet.
LAB_OAK_ADVICE:
OAK: If a wild
POKéMON appears,
your POKéMON can
fight against it! Afterward, go on
to the next town.
LAB_RIVAL_ILL_TAKE_YOU_ON:
<RIVAL>: Wait
<PLAYER>!
Let's check out
our POKéMON! Come on, I'll take
you on!
LAB_OAK_PIKACHU_DISLIKES:
OAK: Would you
look at that! It's odd, but it
appears that your
PIKACHU dislikes
POKé BALLs. You should just
keep it with you. That should make
it happy! You can talk to it
and see how it
feels about you.
LAB_RIVAL_SMELL_YOU_LATER:
<RIVAL>: Okay!
I'll make my
POKéMON fight to
toughen it up! <PLAYER>! Gramps!
Smell you later!
LAB_RIVAL_WRONG_POKEMON:
WHAT?
Unbelievable!
I picked the
wrong POKéMON!
LAB_RIVAL_MON_STRONGER:
<RIVAL>: Heh, my
POKéMON looks a
lot stronger.
LAB_OAK_DELIVER_PARCEL:
OAK: Oh, <PLAYER>! How is my old
POKéMON? Well, it seems to
like you a lot. You must be
talented as a
POKéMON trainer! What? You have
something for me? <PLAYER> delivered
OAK's PARCEL.
LAB_OAK_PARCEL_THANKS:
Ah! This is the
custom POKé BALL
I ordered!
Thanks, <PLAYER>! By the way, I must
ask you to do
something for me.
LAB_RIVAL_MON_GROWN:
<RIVAL>: Gramps,
my POKéMON has
grown stronger!
Check it out!
LAB_OAK_HAVE_A_REQUEST:
OAK: Ah, <RIVAL>,
good timing! I needed to ask
both of you to do
something for me.
LAB_OAK_POKEDEX_SPEECH:
On the desk there
is my invention,
POKéDEX! It automatically
records data on
POKéMON you've
seen or caught! It's a hi-tech
encyclopedia!
LAB_OAK_GOT_POKEDEX:
OAK: <PLAYER> and
<RIVAL>! Take
these with you! <PLAYER> got
POKéDEX from OAK!
LAB_OAK_DREAM_SPEECH:
To make a complete
guide on all the
POKéMON in the
world... That was my dream! But, I'm too old!
I can't do it! So, I want you two
to fulfill my
dream for me! Get moving, you
two! This is a great
undertaking in
POKéMON history!
LAB_RIVAL_LEAVE_IT_TO_ME:
<RIVAL>: Alright
Gramps! Leave it
all to me! <PLAYER>, I hate to
say it, but I
don't need you! I know! I'll
borrow a TOWN MAP
from my sis! I'll tell her not
to lend you one,
<PLAYER>! Hahaha!
LAB_OAK_POKEMON_AROUND_WORLD:
POKéMON around the
world wait for
you, <PLAYER>!
LAB_OAK_TALK_TO_IT:
OAK: You should
talk to it and
see how it feels.
MART_CLERK_PALLET_TOWN:
Hey! You came from
PALLET TOWN?
MART_CLERK_PARCEL_QUEST:
You know PROF.
OAK, right? His order came in.
Will you take it
to him?
MART_CLERK_SAY_HI:
Okay! Say hi to
PROF.OAK for me!
SCHOOL_NOTEBOOK_PAGE1:
First page... POKé BALLs are
used to catch
POKéMON. Up to 6 POKéMON
can be carried. People who raise
and make POKéMON
fight are called
POKéMON trainers.
SCHOOL_NOTEBOOK_PAGE2:
Second page... A healthy POKéMON
may be hard to
catch, so weaken
it first! Poison, burns and
other damage are
effective!
SCHOOL_NOTEBOOK_PAGE3:
Third page... POKéMON trainers
seek others to
engage in POKéMON
fights. Battles are
constantly fought
at POKéMON GYMs.
SCHOOL_NOTEBOOK_PAGE4:
Fourth page... The goal for
POKéMON trainers
is to beat the 
top 8 POKéMON
GYM LEADERs. Do so to earn the
right to face... The ELITE FOUR of
POKéMON LEAGUE!
SCHOOL_GIRL_REACTION:
GIRL: Hey! Don't
look at my notes!
OAK_SPEECH_1:
Hello there!
Welcome to the
world of POKéMON! My name is OAK!
People call me
the POKéMON PROF!
OAK_SPEECH_PIKACHU:
This world is
inhabited by
creatures called
POKéMON!
OAK_SPEECH_RIVAL_ASK:
This is my grand-
son. He's been
your rival since
you were a baby. ...Erm, what is
his name again?
OAK_SPEECH_RIVAL_CONFIRM:
That's right! I
remember now! His
name is <RIVAL>!
OAK_SPEECH_FINAL:
<PLAYER>! Your very own
POKéMON legend is
about to unfold! A world of dreams
and adventures
with POKéMON
awaits! Let's go!
ROUTE1_POTION_FOLLOWUP:
We also carry
POKé BALLs for
catching POKéMON!
ROUTE1_MART_SAMPLE:
Hi! I work at a
POKéMON MART. It's a convenient
shop, so please
visit us in
VIRIDIAN CITY. I know, I'll give
you a sample!
Here you go!
VIRIDIAN_GIRL_PEWTER:
When I go shop in
PEWTER CITY, I
have to take the
winding trail in
VIRIDIAN FOREST.
VIRIDIAN_CATERPILLAR_ASK:
You want to know
about the 2 kinds
of caterpillar
POKéMON?
VIRIDIAN_OLDMAN_COFFEE:
Ahh, I've had my
coffee now and I
feel great! Sure, you can go
through! I'm sorry I was
so rude to you! I see you're using
a POKéDEX. I'll show you how
to catch POKéMON
as my apology.
VIRIDIAN_OLDMAN_LOSING_TOUCH:
That didn't work!
I must be losing
my touch. I've run out of
POKé BALLs too. I have to get some
at POKéMON MART.
VIRIDIAN_OLDMAN_WEAKEN_TARGET:
First, you need
to weaken the
target POKéMON.
VIRIDIAN_OLDMAN_SHOW_AGAIN:
Hmm? You want me
to show you how
to catch POKéMON
again?
VIRIDIAN_OLDMAN_WATCH_CLOSELY:
Dandy! Watch what
I do closely now!
VIRIDIAN_OLDMAN_NOT_GOOD_ENOUGH:
Oh... I'm not good
enough for you.
VIRIDIAN_OLDMAN_PRIVATE_PROPERTY:
You can't go
through here! This is private
property!
ROUTE2_GATE_FLASH_EXPLANATION:
The HM FLASH
lights even the
darkest dungeons.
BLUES_HOUSE_USE_MAP:
Use the TOWN MAP
to find out where
you are.
BATTLE_SO_CLOSE:
Shoot! It was so
close too!
RIVAL1_WIN:
<RIVAL>: Yeah! Am
I great or what?
PC_NO_MON_HERE:
What? There are
no POKéMON here!
PC_CANT_DEPOSIT_LAST:
You can't deposit
the last POKéMON!
PC_BOX_FULL:
Oops! This Box is
full of POKéMON.
POKECENTER_WELCOME:
Welcome to our
POKéMON CENTER! We heal your
POKéMON back to
perfect health!
POKECENTER_FIGHTING_FIT:
Thank you!
Your POKéMON are
fighting fit!
MOM_REST:
MOM: <PLAYER>, if
you drive your
POKéMON too hard,
they'll dislike
you. You should take a
rest.
MOM_LOOKING_GREAT:
MOM: Oh good!
You and your
POKéMON are
looking great!
Take care now!
BLACKBOARD_INTRO:
The blackboard
describes POKéMON
STATUS changes
during battles.
BLACKBOARD_SLEEP:
A POKéMON can't
attack if it's
asleep! POKéMON will stay
asleep even after
battles. Use AWAKENING to
wake them up!
BLACKBOARD_POISON:
When poisoned, a
POKéMON's health
steadily drops. Poison lingers
after battles. Use an ANTIDOTE
to cure poison!
BLACKBOARD_PARALYSIS:
Paralysis could
make POKéMON
moves misfire! Paralysis remains
after battles. Use PARLYZ HEAL
for treatment!
BLACKBOARD_FREEZE:
If frozen, a
POKéMON becomes
totally immobile! It stays frozen
even after the
battle ends. Use ICE HEAL to
thaw out POKéMON!
LAB_OAK_CHOOSE_MON_2:
Ah, whatever!
Just wait there. Look, <PLAYER>! Do
you see that ball
on the table? It's called a POKé
BALL. It holds a
POKéMON inside. You may have it!
Go on, take it!
PC_CANT_TAKE_MORE:
You can't take
any more POKéMON.
VIRIDIAN_OLDMAN_DEMO:
Ahh, I've had my
coffee now and I
feel great! But this is as far
as the demo goes! Thanks for playing!
